fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 28% match is a WEAK FIT for this Program Manager role, mainly because you have no B2B SaaS or customer onboarding experience.

**Strengths:**
- Curriculum design: wrote Year 9 practical curriculum, trained 12 colleagues
- Workshop facilitation and one-to-one coaching translate to enablement content
- Spreadsheet progress tracking presented to senior leadership each term

**Gaps:**
- No B2B SaaS experience (4+ years required)
- No customer onboarding or technical product implementation background
- No webinar, marketing collaboration, or project management experience shown

**Recommendation:** Build experience in customer success or onboarding at a SaaS company first, then reapply once you can show program metrics and customer-facing results.

Hiring Manager
Figma

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your scale onboarding program has to guide a high volume of commercial customers through onboarding without losing the personal touch. I know that problem from the classroom: I teach about 140 students a year across Years 9 to 13, and getting each of them to a real outcome means building materials and routines that work at volume.

My approach is to build the resource once, test it, and teach others to use it. As Teacher of Physics and Head of Year 9 at Ashgrove Academy, I wrote the department's Year 9 practical curriculum and trained 12 colleagues to use it. Over 8 years in the classroom I've done workshop facilitation and one-to-one coaching, and I've explained complex ideas to people of very different backgrounds, from students to parents to senior leadership. Each term I track progress in spreadsheets and present results to senior leadership, which is the habit behind your focus on metrics and customer feedback. I work in Excel, Google Sheets and basic Python (pandas), and I'm finishing the Google Data Analytics Certificate. I haven't worked in B2B SaaS, but I learn new tools quickly, and "Grow as you go" describes how I work.

I'd welcome a conversation about how this experience could help you develop content and enablement resources for the London team. I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor

Dear Hiring Team,

I wrote my department's Year 9 practical curriculum and trained 12 colleagues to use it, which is the same kind of program building and enablement work your Scale Onboarding role needs. After 8 years in the classroom, I'm used to keeping many learners on track at once and reporting their progress to senior leadership each term. My CV and cover letter are attached for you to look through. I'm available for a call any weekday after 4pm UK time.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor
